summary.name: Presentations.AI
summary.one_liner: Presentations.AI is an AI presentation platform that turns topics, documents, or URLs into branded, editable PowerPoint decks, with data-connected refresh and API-based generation at scale.
use_cases: Turning a topic, notes, or document into a slide deck
Creating a branded sales or investor pitch deck from a website URL
Refreshing a quarterly or monthly report deck with new data
Generating personalized proposals for many prospects
Embedding AI presentation generation into a product via API
summary.what_it_does: The platform takes input such as a text prompt, notes, PDFs, Word docs, URLs, Google Docs, or Excel files and builds a structured slide deck with a narrative suited to the stated objective (for example investor pitch, sales deck, or board presentation). Its Brand Sync feature pulls logo, fonts, and colors from a pasted website URL. Decks export as editable .pptx files that open in PowerPoint or Google Slides. A Refresh feature lets users keep a master template locked while swapping in new data or recipient details, with scheduled updates connected to sources such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Snowflake. The page also describes REST API, webhooks, Zapier and Make integrations, and white-label use inside other products.
notable: Brand Sync pulls logo, fonts and colors from a website URL
Refresh and scheduled updates regenerate decks from connected data sources
REST API, webhooks, Zapier and Make triggers for generation at scale
SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance claimed
caveats: PowerPoint export and advanced features are listed as upgrade items on the paid tiers; the free Starter tier is limited
Enterprise-scale features such as white-label and multi-team workspaces are described without pricing details
Page is largely marketing; claims such as '12 million customers' are not independently verified
